title: Maria V Probable NDE 9012
content:
Traffic accident with head-on collision. February 1979. My mother drove a Renault 5 and I was in the back seat. We were on a country road and it was raining. At a turning point, a Land Rover with two older men moved into our lane and we collided. My mother stayed in the car with pneumothorax and head trauma without losing consciousness. I was thrown through the front windshield of the car with a Le Fort III facial / skull fracture with loss of cerebrospinal fluid. I remember seeing from the ground level. There was a black image, like a silhouette, of a lady who was walking on the road from right to left. She was calmly, looking down and pulling a shopping cart about 3-4 meters from me. There was nothing else in the experience. I didn't see cars or other people. I only saw the image of the lady who was calmly moving. She did not react to the accident like she was in her own world. I only observed the scene. Later, and I think while I was aware of what had happened, I found myself sitting. But I don't know where this was such as would it be in the ambulance? But sitting? I opened my eyes a little and I was next to my mother who was on my right. I saw her torn skirt and pieces of glass and blood. I didn't look up and I didn't see her face. I just looked down at her skirt and saw the glass and blood. I don't remember any more until getting to the hospital. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 19-01-1979 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Direct head injury. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Traffic accident with head-on collision. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. It was the same. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Only for a moment I saw the lady. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. There was no time. In an instant, I saw the lady walking. She did give the feeling that she was in her own world. She was walking calmly and did not react to the accident. Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The experience took place in dim surroundings. It was not total darkness, but there were no colors and the lady was a black silhouette. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was silence. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place The truth is that it was a dimly lit place but not totally dark. There was nothing except the lady. The accident happened in the middle of the afternoon. It was raining. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt neither happiness nor sadness. I simply watched the image. I was not surprised or scared. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know. I was baptized in the Catholic church, but I was 4 years old. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain I don’t think so because I was 4 years old. What is your religion now? Other or several faiths. I believe in life after death and that we experience several lives before and after the current one. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I was 4 years old and therefore had no elaborate beliefs. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I remember seeing from the ground level. There was a black image, like a silhouette, of a lady who was walking on the road from right to left. She was calmly, looking down and pulling a shopping cart about 3-4 meters from me. There was nothing else in the experience. I didn't see cars or other people. I only saw the image of the lady who was calmly moving. She did not react to the accident like she was in her own world. I only observed the scene. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. The truth that the lady did not seem of this world. Being so close to an accident and not reacting? She was quietly walking with her shopping cart. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Unknown At that

moment, none. But since I regained the memory of the experience and over the years I have gradually become more interested in the meaning of life, life after life, NDEs, and a better understanding of death, meditation, and our spiritual body and how all this can also be applied to medicine. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No. Since I remembered my experience, I have been constantly searching for the Truth all these years of my life, and I continue to do so. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. The memory of the experience emerged after some time ... years later? I do not remember exactly when I became aware of this experience, but I do not think that when I was 4 years old, I was aware of it. I do not know because I cannot say it exactly. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? What was the point of seeing that lady? She was in her own world. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes. Years passed until I remembered and was aware of the experience. Years passed from the time I remembered it until I shared it with my parents. My father reacted with skepticism, which would be a cerebral reaction. My mother expressed doubts about its veracity. We did not mention it again. I have mentioned it to other people but they have not expressed any great interest. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I do not know if at that time I remembered the experience. But when I became aware of the experience, I was convinced that it had happened. Later, I began to have doubts whether it was real or not. Now I think it was real, but that's why I'm writing to you. It does not resemble most of the NDEs that are described. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was probably real. I think it was real, perhaps influenced by my culture and by my great interest in these issues. But I can't offer a 100% guarantee, because it’s not similar to other NDEs. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I would like one day to get to know more about the experience, who was that lady, and the meaning of having had this experience. Perhaps the meaning was to help me develop an interest in spirituality?
